# netbox_virtual_chassis_master (Resource)

This resource is used to define the master device of a virtual chassis. Modelled as a separate resource (like `netbox_device_primary_ip`) to avoid a dependency cycle between the virtual chassis and its member devices. The device has to be a member of the virtual chassis. Do not combine it with `virtual_chassis_master` on the same device, or add `ignore_changes = [virtual_chassis_master]` to the device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_chassis" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "netbox_device" "member" {
  name                     = "member"
  device_type_id           = netbox_device_type.example.id
  role_id                  = netbox_device_role.example.id
  site_id                  = netbox_site.example.id
  virtual_chassis_id       = netbox_virtual_chassis.example.id
  virtual_chassis_position = 1
  virtual_chassis_master   = false

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [virtual_chassis_master]
  }
}

resource "netbox_virtual_chassis_master" "example" {
  virtual_chassis_id = netbox_virtual_chassis.example.id
  master_id          = netbox_device.member.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `master_id` (Number) The ID of the device that is the master of the virtual chassis.
- `virtual_chassis_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual chassis.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the virtual chassis
terraform import netbox_virtual_chassis_master.example 1
```
